skills.text_en: Dodges a POW/INT move. Lose all your GUTS.
Play with a POW/INT move from a monster that has 2 or less HP. It doubles the damage.

skills.name: 底力
skills.text_en: If this monster would reach exactly 0 HP from a POW/INT move, it survives with 1 HP instead.
Play this with a POW/INT move. +2 damage.
Can be played only if your opponent plays a card that damages multiple monsters. They all dodge it.
Can only be played if your deck is empty. Play this with a POW/INT move. Triples the damage.
Sacrifice this monster. Take cards from your discards equal to its remaining HP and place them in your GUTS pile.
Play against a POW move. Take double damage. Triples the damage of this monster's POW moves next turn.
If this is your last monster, it can attack this turn without becoming exhausted.
This monster cannot play BLK/DGE until your next turn. Doubles the damage of this monster next turn.
Choose an opponent's monster. It cannot attack next turn.
Play with a POW/INT move. Any BLK/DGE that costs zero GUTS cannot be played.
Play against a POW/INT move that lowers your GUTS. It will have no effect.
Play with a POW/INT move from a monster that has 2 or less HP. +2 damage.
Play with a POW/INT move from a purebred monster. It cannot be dodged by a mixedbred monster.
Play with a POW/INT move that damages multiple monsters. The cost is halved, rounded up.
Play with a SPE move. Allows a mixedbred monster to play a SPE move from its sub-monster.
Play with a POW/INT move. It cannot be dodged or blocked by a monster that has already used a BLK/DGE this turn.
Blocks 1 damage from a POW move.
